_note: Numbered document series (decision 167, made generic by decision 182). A case type configures, per series, the prefix printed in front of the running number: documentSeries.<series>.prefix, e.g. {"beschikking": {"prefix": "B"}}. The number itself is one running count per series, per organisation, per year, issued by DocumentSeriesNumberer; a series the case type does not configure prints the issuing code's default. Declared on caseType because OpenRegister's magic mapper stores no undeclared key.

documentSeries.title: Document numbering
documentSeries.description: Per kind of document, the letters printed before its number, for example B for a beschikking. The number itself counts up per organisation and starts again each year.
